title: Visual Continuity Manifest, version 1
description: The master map linking every story in your universe to its scene files and character continuity cards. In Andrej Karpathy first-principles style, this file answers one simple question: 'Where do the scenes, outfits, and pictures for each story live?'

stories.description: Dictionary of stories, keyed by unique story slug (e.g. 'main-story', 'tokyo-night').

file.description: Path to story overview or blueprint file.

scenes_file.description: Path to the JSON file containing all scenes for this story.

continuity_file.description: Path to the JSON file containing wardrobe and props continuity cards.

status.description: Whether this story is active, in-progress draft, or retired.

require_continuity.description: If true, every scene in this story must have matching continuity cards.

require_blocking.description: If true, every shot must declare physical room blocking and prop hands.
